Mathematician Claims AI Helped Solve 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis

Levent Alpöge, a mathematician at Anthropic, claims to have solved the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis with the assistance of Anthropic's AI tool, Claude. Alpöge stated it took six weeks to develop the proof using the AI. The mathematical proof is currently awaiting independent verification.
